title: Vanishing conormal for flat morphism with open diagonal
statement: Let f:X → S be a flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism] whose diagonal is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For any universal first order thickening i:X → X′, s:X′ → S of f [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening], its conormal sheaf i*(ker i) [def-weil-pbc-conormal-sheaf-formally-unramified, def-pc-module-pullback] is zero. Finite type is not needed: the open diagonal already implies formal unramifiedness [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism].

proof.text: Construct iZ : X ×_S X -> X ×_S X′ by pairing the first projection with the second projection followed by i. Apply universalFirstOrderThickening_flat_base_change to f along itself, obtaining a universal thickening HZ for q = pullback.fst f f and an invertible canonical conormal map c : p* C_f -> C_q, where p = pullback.snd f f. Formal unramifiedness of f is inferred from its open diagonal.
The diagonal is an open immersion and its composite with q is the identity. Apply open_iso_conormal_isZero to HZ along the diagonal. Pull c back along the diagonal to deduce that Δ* p* C_f is zero.

The composition comparison identifies Δ* p* C_f with (Δ ≫ p)* C_f. The diagonal projection equation makes this identity pullback, and the identity comparison identifies it with C_f. Transport IsZero through these isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem flat_openDiagonal_conormal_isZero {X S X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal f)]
    (i : X ⟶ X') (s : X' ⟶ S) (H : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening f i s) :
    IsZero (formallyUnramifiedConormal f i s H)
